text: ぼうそうぞく…　よく　みかける　けど　こわそうで　いやだわ

structure.jp: よく　みかける　けど

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.explanation: そう put on a describing word, in place of its last い, says how something looks, and で joins it to what follows with 'and'. こわそうで = 'they look scary and'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two statements with 'but'. よく みかける けど = 'I see them a lot, but'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence gives it a soft, feminine tone. いやだわ = 'I don't like them'.
